chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan from Wahb from Abu Baseer from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who left his paternal aunt and his maternal aunt, he said: For the paternal aunt is two-thirds and for the maternal aunt is one-third.
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a paternal aunt versus a maternal aunt in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the specific distribution of the estate among collateral relatives, assigning two-thirds to the paternal aunt and one-third to the maternal aunt. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that the paternal line often holds precedence in inheritance shares over the maternal line when no closer heirs exist. The hadith serves as a practical application of the general Quranic inheritance rules, providing detailed allocation where the Quranic text is more general.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan, from Waheyb, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding a man who left his paternal aunt and his maternal aunt. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the paternal aunt is the two-thirds and for the maternal aunt is the one-third’.
en.sarwar: 5. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan from Wuhayb from abu Basir

who has narrated the following: “About the case of a man who has left behind his paternal aunt and maternal aunt, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The paternal aunt receives two-thirds and the maternal aunt receives one- third.’”
